title: Words to read and colour: Al-Ma'un
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 50 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 50. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Al-Ma'un). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ (١) فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ (٢) وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ (٣) فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ (٤) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ (٥) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ (٦) وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ (٧)

panels.title: What it means
points: A translation of the meaning, not the Qur'an itself

cards: Sharing food with a poor family
blocks.title: Sort into: Kind: Allah loves it / Unkind: Al-Ma'un warns
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Kind: Allah loves it, Unkind: Al-Ma'un warns.
blocks.answer: Kind: Allah loves it: Sharing food with a poor family; Lending a pencil. Unkind: Al-Ma'un warns: Pushing away an orphan; Praying only to show off

questions.q: Say Al-Ma'un together, then in two halves (1 to 3, 4 to 7).
Listening turns: today's group says Al-Ma'un to the teacher. Everyone else: draw a kind action from Al-Ma'un on the pupil PDF (food, a cup, a pencil; no people).
Extend: do one kind action from Al-Ma'un at home.

options: feed the poor and pray with care
questions.a: A) feed the poor and pray with care. 107:3 to 7.

questions.q: 107:2 warns about someone who pushes away the ...
Think again: Al-Ma'un talks about prayer and about being kind. Why do you think Allah puts them together?
questions.a: A person who truly prays for Allah is also kind to people: both come from the heart.
